items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] he played in Emmett's first band, right Harry? I think so John... [INTERVIEWEE] I had a brother between Larry and I, played piano. Edward. Edward. I think you played with him, didn't you, John? Did you know him? Ed, the piano player?

ctx.x: a remark first. Since Harry played with Emmett Hardy so much I'd like to know, there's been a lot of discussion about what style Emmett played in, I'd like to ask Harry what he remembers about his style. He played with Emmett Hardy in Brownlee's band before I joined it and he played with Emmett Hardy I guess maybe more than anybody else in New Orleans. I think he told me
he played in Emmett's first band, right Harry? I think so John, that was the first band he organized up at, we opened the Midway Park up at, what was it, Harvey's Canal there, across the river?
On the other side of the river? On the other side of the river. Midway Park.
